title: discord.intake output
description: Exactly one terminal outcome of an admitted intent, discriminated by status — the runtime's actual projection shapes, with no extra fields on any variant. unauthorized: the author is not owner-paired — the receipt carries ONLY the status, with no author, channel, or content echo (anti-enumeration; nothing is recorded or executed). governance_rejected: the durable record is kept but settled terminally Rejected by kernel capability governance — execution never happens and replays return the same shape with no task key. recorded: exactly one durable task was created, carrying the command id (command:discord-intent:<32 lowercase hex>); the receipt carries no content fields — the 2000-char content lives solely in the durable ledger arguments. duplicate: a replayed intent — the SAME task id as the original is returned, nothing re-executes. gated: the durable task's consequential leg stopped at the ledger approval gate and carries the bound kernel-minted approval id (approval:discord-intent:<32 lowercase hex>); the approval is consumed exactly once through the ingress gate, never twice. A denial is recorded durably with its evidence reference and never produces a sent effect.
